definition_zh: v. （烹饪）把油脂或肉汁浇淋在烤肉上；（缝纫）用长针脚粗缝、假缝；（旧用）痛打
definition_en: to moisten roasting meat with fat or its own juices; to join cloth with long loose temporary stitches; in older use, to thrash
core_image: 烤箱门一开，一勺滚热的盘底汁水浇回焦黄的肉面
scene: 烤箱门一开，她就把盘底的汁水浇回肉上。She opened the oven and used the pan juices to baste the meat.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：baste 指烹饪中把油脂或汁液浇淋在烤肉上；句意是她用盘底肉汁浇淋烤肉。

senses.title: To moisten roasting meat
senses.definition: to pour fat or pan juices over meat while it cooks so that it stays moist
senses.definitionCN: 肉在烤制过程中把油脂或盘底汁液浇在其上，使其不干
senses.example: Baste the joint twice while it rests in the heat.
senses.exampleCN: 肉块在炉中静置时浇两次汁。
senses.why: The kitchen sense is the newest of the three, and it is the one most readers meet first.
senses.whyCN: 厨房义是三个义项中最新的一个，也是多数读者最先遇到的。

senses.title: To sew loosely
senses.definition: to join pieces of cloth with long temporary stitches that will be removed later
senses.definitionCN: 用日后会拆掉的长针脚把布料临时缝合
senses.example: She basted the lining before machining the seam.
senses.exampleCN: 她先把衬里粗缝固定，再上机缝接缝。
senses.why: This sense comes from Old French bastir, to build or to sew loosely, so the idea is holding a shape in place.
senses.whyCN: 此义源自古法语 bastir「搭建、松缝」，核心是先把形状固定住。

senses.title: To thrash
senses.definition: in older writing, to beat someone hard
senses.definitionCN: 旧时文献中指狠打某人
senses.example: The old play has a servant basted for his insolence.
senses.exampleCN: 那出旧戏里有个仆人因无礼而被痛打。
senses.why: This verb is probably from Old Norse beysta, to beat, and it survives mainly in older texts.
senses.whyCN: 该动词可能源自古诺斯语 beysta「击打」，如今主要见于旧文献。

intro.en: Baste is really three verbs sharing one spelling: a sewing word from French, a beating word from Norse, and a kitchen word of uncertain origin that won out.
intro.cn: baste 其实是共用一个拼写的三个动词：来自法语的缝纫词、来自诺斯语的击打词，以及来源不明却最终胜出的厨房词。

items.en: Old Norse beysta meant to beat or thump, one possible source of the word.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 beysta 意为击打，是该词的一个可能来源。

items.en: Old French bastir meant to build or to sew loosely, giving the tailoring sense.
items.cn: 古法语 bastir 意为搭建或松缝，给出缝纫那一义。

items.en: Middle English uses the word for long temporary stitches holding cloth in place.
items.cn: 中古英语用该词指把布料临时固定的长针脚。

items.en: A verb meaning to thrash appears in writing, close in sound to the sewing word.
items.cn: 书面语中出现「痛打」义的动词，与缝纫词读音相近。

items.en: Cookery books use the word for moistening roasting meat with fat and juices.
items.cn: 烹饪书用该词指以油脂与肉汁浇淋烤肉。

items.en: The kitchen sense becomes the commonest, and a baster is sold as a tool for it.
items.cn: 厨房义成为最常用义，并出现名为 baster 的专用工具。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the same long vowel and the -aste shape; the near-meaning group splits into kitchen verbs and the tailoring verb, matching the two live senses.
note.cn: 形近组保留同一个长元音与 -aste 字形；近义组分为厨房动词与缝纫动词两支，正对应两个活跃义项。

scene: 天快黑时，屋檐下掠过一道影子。A bat flew low over the garden.

senses.title: A stick for hitting
senses.definition: a shaped wooden stick used to hit a ball
senses.definitionCN: 用来击球的成形木棒

senses.title: A flying animal

definition_zh: n. 一炉；一批（一次做出或处理的量）；一组（同时处理的人或物）　v. 分批处理
definition_en: a quantity of something produced or dealt with at one time; a group handled together; to divide work into batches
core_image: 凌晨三点整盘推进炉膛的那一炉面包
scene: 面包房凌晨三点开了第一炉，热气把玻璃糊白了。The bakery opened its first batch at three in the morning, and the steam clouded the glass.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：batch 指一次烘烤做出的整批量；句意是面包房凌晨三点开出第一炉。

derivatives.zh: 一批；一组（拍卖或交易用语）

senses.title: One oven load
senses.definition: the whole quantity of bread or other goods produced in a single operation
senses.definitionCN: 一次操作中做出的全部面包或其他产品
senses.example: The second batch came out darker than the first.
senses.exampleCN: 第二炉比第一炉颜色更深。
senses.why: The word is a noun built on bake, so its first meaning is exactly what one heating produces.
senses.whyCN: 该词是建在 bake「烘烤」上的名词，因此初义正是「一次加热所出」。

senses.title: A group handled together
senses.definition: a set of people or things dealt with at the same time

senses.example: A new batch of applicants arrived on Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 周一又来了一批申请人。
senses.why: The oven is dropped and only the togetherness remains, which lets the word cover people and data.
senses.whyCN: 烤炉被抽掉，只剩「一起」这一层，于是该词也能指人和数据。

senses.title: To group into batches
senses.definition: to arrange work or data so that it is processed in groups rather than one by one
senses.definitionCN: 把作业或数据安排成组处理，而非逐件处理
senses.example: The system batches the invoices overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 系统在夜间把发票分批处理。
senses.why: Computing turned the noun back into a verb, because queued group processing is exactly the oven pattern.
senses.whyCN: 计算机把这个名词又转回动词，因为排队成组处理正是烤炉那一套模式。

intro.en: Batch is a noun grown out of bake: one heating of the oven, then any set made or handled together, then a computing term.
intro.cn: batch 是从 bake「烘烤」长出的名词：先是炉中一次加热，再是任何一起制作或处理的集合，最后成为计算机术语。

items.en: The root bhe meant to warm or heat, the deep source of bake.
items.cn: 词根 bhe 意为使暖、加热，是 bake 的深层来源。

items.en: Old English bacan meant to bake, and its noun side gave a word for a baking.
items.cn: 古英语 bacan 意为烘烤，其名词一侧给出「一次烘烤」之词。

items.en: Middle English bache names the whole quantity of bread baked in one heating.
items.cn: 中古英语 bache 指一次加热中烤出的全部面包。

items.en: The spelling settles as batch, still tied to the oven.
items.cn: 拼写定为 batch，仍与烤炉相连。

items.en: The word widens from bread to any set of things made or handled together.
items.cn: 词义由面包扩为任何一起制作或处理的集合。

items.en: Batch processing names work queued and run without a person at each step.
items.cn: 批处理指排队执行、无需逐步人工干预的作业。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the -atch shape so the spelling sticks; the near-meaning group covers trade, shipping and statistics words for a group.
note.cn: 形近组保留 -atch 字形以固化拼写；近义组覆盖贸易、航运与统计中表示「一组」的词。

definition_zh: n. （有孔的）小珠；（液体的）小滴、珠；珠状窄条（焊道、胶线）　v. 以珠饰缀；成珠状
definition_en: a small ball with a hole for threading; a small round drop of liquid; a narrow ridge of material such as weld or glue; to decorate with beads
core_image: 灯下额头上那一排细小的汗珠
scene: 她额上渗出一层细汗，灯下像一排小珠。Beads of sweat stood on her forehead and caught the lamplight.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：bead 指液体的小圆滴；句意是额头上的汗珠在灯下发亮。

senses.title: A threaded ball
senses.definition: a small ball of glass, wood or stone with a hole so it can be strung with others
senses.definitionCN: 玻璃、木或石制的小球，中有孔可与其他珠串在一起
senses.example: She threaded blue beads onto a waxed cord.
senses.exampleCN: 她把蓝珠子穿到一条上过蜡的绳上。
senses.why: The word reached this object through counting prayers, so the hole matters more than the material.
senses.whyCN: 该词是通过「数祷告」抵达这件实物的，因此「有孔」比材质更关键。

senses.title: A round drop
senses.definition: a small round drop of liquid standing on a surface
senses.definitionCN: 停在表面上的小圆液滴
senses.example: Beads of rain clung to the cold window.
senses.exampleCN: 冰冷的窗上挂着一粒粒雨珠。
senses.why: Shape alone carries the transfer: anything small, round and standing free is called a bead.
senses.whyCN: 这一引申只靠形状：凡小、圆、独立成粒者皆可称 bead。

senses.title: A narrow ridge
senses.definition: a continuous narrow line of weld metal, sealant or glue
senses.definitionCN: 焊料、密封胶或胶水形成的连续窄条
senses.example: Run a thin bead of sealant along the joint.
senses.exampleCN: 沿接缝打一道细胶。
senses.why: A line of drops laid touching becomes a ridge, so the technical sense keeps the same round profile.
senses.whyCN: 一串相接的液滴就成了窄条，因此技术义保留了同样的圆形截面。

intro.en: Bead once meant prayer. The little balls used to count prayers borrowed the name, and then the name forgot the prayer and kept the ball.
intro.cn: bead 曾意为「祷告」。用来数祷告的小球借走了这个名字，随后名字忘掉了祷告，只留下那颗球。

items.en: Old English gebed meant a prayer, from the verb biddan, to ask.
items.cn: 古英语 gebed 意为祷告，出自 biddan「请求」。

items.en: Middle English bede keeps the sense of prayer, and counting prayers becomes a habit.
items.cn: 中古英语 bede 保留「祷告」义，数祷告成为习惯。

items.en: The small balls used to count prayers take the name of the prayers themselves.
items.cn: 用来数祷告的小球取用了祷告本身的名字。

items.en: The spelling fixes on the object, and the meaning prayer fades away.
items.cn: 拼写固定在实物上，「祷告」义渐退。

items.en: Any small round drop is called a bead, from sweat to rain on glass.
items.cn: 任何小圆滴都被称作 bead，从汗珠到玻璃上的雨点。

items.en: Welding and gluing borrow the word for a narrow continuous ridge of material.
items.cn: 焊接与涂胶借该词指一条连续窄凸的材料。

note.en: The look-alike group holds other short -ea- words that learners confuse in spelling; the near-meaning group separates round ornaments from round drops.

senses.title: The dam-building animal
senses.definition: a large rodent with a flat tail that cuts trees and builds dams and lodges in water
senses.definitionCN: 一种尾扁的大型啮齿动物，会啃树并在水中筑坝造巢
senses.example: A beaver can fell a small tree in one night.
senses.exampleCN: 河狸一夜就能啃倒一棵小树。
senses.why: The name is ancient and simply meant the brown one, so the animal was labelled by its colour.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字很古老，本义就是「那个棕色的家伙」，所以这动物是按颜色被命名的。

senses.title: Its fur or a felt hat

senses.example: He wore a beaver pulled low against the wind.

senses.why: The fur was so valuable that the material name could stand for the finished hat.
senses.whyCN: 这种毛皮极为贵重，以致材料名可以直接代指做成的帽子。

senses.title: To work hard
senses.definition: in British informal use, to work steadily and busily at a task
senses.definitionCN: 英式非正式用法，指持续而忙碌地做一件事
senses.example: She beavered away at the accounts all weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 她整个周末都在埋头处理账目。
senses.why: The animal is a byword for tireless building, so the verb borrows its reputation.
senses.whyCN: 这种动物是不倦营造的代名词，因此动词借走了它的名声。

intro.en: Beaver is one of the oldest animal names in English, and it means simply the brown one. The fur trade and British slang added the other two senses.
intro.cn: beaver 是英语中最古老的动物名之一，本义就是「棕色的那个」。毛皮贸易与英国俚语补上了另外两个义项。

items.en: The root bher meant bright or brown, the colour that named the animal.
items.cn: 词根 bher 意为明亮或棕色，正是给这动物命名的颜色。

items.en: A reduplicated form names the brown water animal itself.
items.cn: 一个叠音形式直接指这种棕色的水生动物。

items.en: Germanic keeps the word for the animal across the northern languages.
items.cn: 日耳曼语在北方诸语言中保留该动物名。

items.en: Old English beofor is the everyday name, valued for fur and for castoreum.
items.cn: 古英语 beofor 是日常名称，因其毛皮与河狸香而受重视。

items.en: Beaver felt makes the best hats, so the word alone can mean a beaver hat.
items.cn: 河狸毛毡做出最好的帽子，因此该词单用即可指河狸帽。

items.en: British slang turns the busy animal into a verb, to beaver away at a task.
items.cn: 英国俚语把这种忙碌动物变成动词：beaver away 埋头苦干。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the -eaver ending, which is where the spelling trouble lies; the near-meaning group lists water rodents and the verb the animal is famous for.
note.cn: 形近组保留 -eaver 词尾，拼写难点正在此处；近义组列出水生啮齿动物，以及这动物最著名的那个动作。

senses.title: A four-winged colony insect
senses.titleCN: 蜜蜂：四翅、营群体生活的蜂类
senses.definition: a four-winged insect that lives in a colony, gathers nectar and pollen and makes honey
senses.definitionCN: 四翅、成群生活、采集花蜜与花粉并酿蜜的昆虫
senses.example: A bee gathers pollen from the apple blossom and carries it back to the hive.
senses.exampleCN: 一只蜜蜂从苹果花上采集花粉，带回蜂巢。
senses.why: The everyday sense names the insect itself; the older Germanic word simply meant the buzzing creature, and honey-making is its best-known habit.
senses.whyCN: 日常义就是这种昆虫本身；日耳曼语旧词只表示「嗡嗡叫的小东西」，酿蜜是它最出名的习性。

senses.title: Any member of the bee superfamily
senses.titleCN: 蜂总科的任一成员，包括不酿蜜的种类
senses.definition: any insect of the bee superfamily, including solitary species that do not make honey
senses.definitionCN: 蜂总科的任何昆虫，包括不酿蜜的独居种类
senses.example: Mining bees nest in bare soil and never build a honeycomb.
senses.exampleCN: 地蜂在裸露的土壤里筑巢，从不建蜜脾。
senses.why: Taxonomy widened the label: the family covers solitary as well as colonial species, so honey is not part of the definition.
senses.whyCN: 分类学把称呼放宽了：这一科既有独居种也有群居种，酿蜜并不构成定义的一部分。

senses.title: The insects that pollinate a crop
senses.titleCN: 为一地作物传粉的蜂群
senses.definition: bees treated collectively as the pollinators that a crop or a wild plant depends on
senses.definitionCN: 把蜂视为一个整体，指作物或野生植物所依赖的传粉者
senses.example: Without native bees, the almond orchards set far less fruit.
senses.exampleCN: 没有本地蜂群，杏园结出的果实会少得多。
senses.why: When farmers say the bees, they mean the pollinating work force rather than one insect, so the word shifts from a creature to a service.
senses.whyCN: 农人说的「蜂」指整支传粉劳力，而非某一只昆虫，词义便从个体转向一项服务。

senses.title: A busy, industrious person
senses.definition: a person who is always working, used with a hint of affectionate teasing
senses.definitionCN: 总在干活的人，带一点亲昵的打趣
senses.example: My neighbour is a busy bee, pruning hedges before breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 我那位邻居是个闲不住的忙人，早饭前就在修剪树篱。
senses.why: The metaphor borrows the insect's tireless foraging and applies it to human energy, always with the fixed word busy.
senses.whyCN: 比喻借用蜜蜂不知疲倦的采集，转到人的精力上，且总与「busy」连用。

senses.title: A communal working party
senses.titleCN: 邻里一起干活的聚会（剥玉米会、缝被会）
senses.definition: a gathering of neighbours who work together on one task, such as husking corn or sewing a quilt
senses.definitionCN: 邻里聚在一起完成同一件活的场合，如剥玉米或缝被子
senses.example: The quilting bee finished three covers in a single afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 这场缝被聚会一个下午就做好了三床被面。
senses.why: Frontier life turned a solitary chore into a social event, and the insect's colony became the model for people working side by side.
senses.whyCN: 拓荒生活把独做的杂活变成社交场合，蜜蜂的群体便成了并排干活的样板。

senses.title: A spelling competition
senses.definition: a contest in which competitors take turns spelling words aloud until only one remains
senses.definitionCN: 参赛者轮流口头拼写单词、直到只剩一人的比赛
senses.example: She won the county spelling bee by spelling a hard word calmly.
senses.exampleCN: 她沉着地拼出一个难词，赢下了县里的拼写比赛。
senses.why: The contest borrowed the gathering sense of bee, a meeting for a shared activity, and kept only the insect name as a fossil.
senses.whyCN: 比赛借用了 bee 的「聚会」义，即为一件事聚在一起，只把昆虫名当作凝固的残迹留下。

senses.title: Hive products sold as food
senses.titleCN: 蜂产品（作定语，如蜂花粉）
senses.definition: honey and other hive products, sold under labels such as bee pollen or bee honey
senses.definitionCN: 蜂蜜及其他蜂巢产品，常以蜂花粉、蜂蜜之类的名称出售
senses.example: The farm sells bee pollen beside jars of honey.
senses.exampleCN: 农场在蜂蜜罐旁出售蜂花粉。
senses.why: Here bee works as a noun modifier naming the source of the product rather than the animal.
senses.whyCN: 此处 bee 作名词修饰语，指产品的来源，而非动物本身。

senses.title: A loud communal gathering
senses.titleCN: 热闹的集体活动（旧时乡村用法）
senses.definition: any lively gathering organized around a shared task or amusement, especially in older rural usage
senses.definitionCN: 围绕同一件事或娱乐而形成的热闹聚会，尤见于旧时乡村
senses.example: The barn raising turned into a bee that lasted until dark.
senses.exampleCN: 那场建仓互助会最后变成热闹的蜂会，一直闹到天黑。
senses.why: The older rural sense generalizes the work party into any crowded, buzzing occasion, and the noise of the hive supplies the image.
senses.whyCN: 旧时乡村义把互助干活扩展为任何拥挤喧闹的场合，蜂巢的嗡鸣提供了意象。

intro.en: Bee descends from Old English bēo, a Germanic word for the honeybee whose plural was bēon. Latin apis, the other great source of bee vocabulary, is not related to it.
intro.cn: bee 来自古英语 bēo，是日耳曼语中指蜜蜂的词，复数作 bēon。拉丁 apis 是另一条蜂类词汇的来源，与它并非同源。

items.en: Old English bēo named the honeybee, with the plural bēon; the modern plural bees was reshaped on the model of ordinary nouns.
items.cn: 古英语 bēo 指蜜蜂，复数作 bēon；现代复数 bees 是按普通名词的样式重塑的。

items.en: Old High German bīa, Old Norse bȳ and Gothic bī- point to a reconstructed Germanic form *bijō, which is a reconstruction rather than an attested word.
items.cn: 古高地德语 bīa、古北欧语 bȳ 与哥特语 bī- 指向重构的日耳曼语形式 *bijō，这是重构形式，并非有记录的词。

items.en: A link between the word and a root meaning 'to buzz or tremble' has been suggested because of the insect's hum; the suggestion is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated derivation.
items.cn: 有人因这种昆虫的嗡鸣，把该词与意为「嗡嗡作响、颤动」的词根联系起来；这只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: Latin apis 'bee' survives in English only inside borrowed technical words such as apiary and apiculture, so it never replaced the everyday noun.
items.cn: 拉丁 apis「蜜蜂」只保留在 apiary、apiculture 这类借入的技术词里，从未取代日常名词。

items.en: From the eighteenth century, American rural usage called a communal work party a bee, and the same pattern later produced the spelling bee.
items.cn: 从 18 世纪起，美国乡村用法把邻里互助干活称作 bee，同一模式后来又造出拼写比赛一词。

items.en: Source uncertain (detail and first date): the deeper origin and the exact first citation are not settled, so any pre-Latin form offered here is a reconstruction and competing hypotheses are left side by side.
items.cn: 来源不确定（细节与首见年代）：更深的来源与确切最早书证均无定论，此处给出的拉丁语之前形式属重构形式，并列假说一并保留、不作定论。

note.en: Group one gathers words that are close in sound or spelling but come from other roots; group two gathers the insects most often compared with bees.
note.cn: 第一组收同音或形近但来源不同的词；第二组收最常与蜜蜂相比的昆虫。

entries.definition: The verb be is a grammatical word with no connection to the insect; the shared sound is accident, not kinship.
entries.definitionCN: 动词 be 是语法词，与这种昆虫无关；同音只是巧合，并非同源。

entries.definition: Been is the past participle of be, close in sound but built from a completely different grammatical stock.
entries.definitionCN: been 是 be 的过去分词，读音相近，却来自完全不同的语法系统。

entries.definition: Bean names a seed of the legume family; the identical sound hides an unrelated history.
entries.definitionCN: bean 指豆科植物的种子；完全相同的读音掩盖着互不相干的历史。

entries.definition: A beetle is a different order of insect with hardened wing covers; the spelling overlap is misleading.
entries.definitionCN: 甲虫属于另一个目，翅鞘坚硬；拼写上的重合具有误导性。

entries.definition: A wasp has a slender waist and a stinger and is not a bee, though both belong to the same broad order.
entries.definitionCN: 黄蜂腰细、有蜇针，不是蜜蜂，尽管两者同属一个较大的目。

entries.definition: Honeybee names the species kept for honey, the closest everyday relative of bee.
entries.definitionCN: honeybee 指为取蜜而饲养的种类，是 bee 在日常用语中最贴近的同族词。

entries.definition: A bumblebee is a big, densely hairy bee that nests in small colonies underground.
entries.definitionCN: 熊蜂是体型大、绒毛密的蜂，在地下筑小群体巢。

entries.definition: A hornet is a large social wasp whose sting is feared; it is a wasp, not a bee.
entries.definitionCN: 胡蜂是体大的社会性黄蜂，蜇人厉害；它属黄蜂，不是蜜蜂。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Germanic root gives the everyday noun, the compounds and the collective plural bees.
normal.cn: 日耳曼词根给出日常名词、复合词与集合复数 bees。

normal.en: The family runs bee, beehive, beekeeper, beeswax, honeybee, bumblebee and beeline.
normal.cn: 词族包括 bee、beehive、beekeeper、beeswax、honeybee、bumblebee 与 beeline。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: queen bee, worker bee, spelling bee, bee pollen.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：蜂王、工蜂、拼写比赛、蜂花粉。

normal.en: Busy as a bee is the standard simile for tireless work.
normal.cn: 忙得像蜜蜂是形容不知疲倦的固定比喻。

normal.en: A colony has three castes: queen, workers and drones.
normal.cn: 蜂群有三个等级：蜂王、工蜂与雄蜂。

abstract.en: Picture a city built entirely of hexagonal rooms, each holding one sleeping larva.
abstract.cn: 想象一座全由六角房间构成的城，每间里睡着一只幼虫。

abstract.en: Picture pollen as yellow luggage strapped to a traveller's legs.
abstract.cn: 想象花粉是绑在旅人腿上的黄色行李。

abstract.en: Picture a hall of voices taking turns, each voice spelling one word.
abstract.cn: 想象一间大厅，声音轮流响起，每个声音拼出一个词。

examples.en: Wild bees pollinate most of the orchard before the honeybee hives arrive.
examples.cn: 在蜜蜂箱运来之前，野生蜂群已经为果园完成了大部分传粉。

examples.en: The children's spelling bee ended in a tie after forty rounds.
examples.cn: 儿童拼写比赛经过四十轮后以平局收场。

examples.en: She keeps two hives and sells bee pollen at the weekend market.
examples.cn: 她养了两箱蜂，周末市场上卖蜂花粉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「bee（必）」——必到花前去采蜜的小虫 → 蜜蜂；bee 又指大家聚在一起的「蜂会」

root: 古英语 bēo「蜜蜂」；日耳曼语同源词指向重构形式 *bijō；更早的印欧来源不确定，拟声假说（嗡嗡声）未获证实。拉丁 apis 与英语 bee 不是同源词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one insect: a forager loads pollen, returns to a colony, is imitated as a model of hard work, and finally lends its name to communal gatherings and a spelling contest.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一只昆虫展开：采粉者装满花粉、回到群体，被当作勤劳的样板，最后把名字借给了邻里聚会与拼写比赛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a forager leaving a flower with full pollen baskets and heading for a hexagonal hive door.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只采粉者带着装满花粉的后腿，从花朵飞向六角形的蜂巢门洞。

branches.en: NECTAR AND POLLEN: the insect body itself, and the whole family of such insects.
branches.cn: 花蜜与花粉：昆虫本体，以及这一整类昆虫。

branches.en: POLLINATION SERVICE: the colony read as unpaid labour in the orchard.
branches.cn: 传粉服务：把蜂群读作果园里的无偿劳力。

branches.en: COMMUNAL LABOUR: human diligence and the neighbour work party borrow the hive's example.
branches.cn: 集体劳动：人的勤勉与邻里互助都借用了蜂巢的样板。

branches.en: HIVE PRODUCTS: the name attaches to what the hive yields, not to the animal.
branches.cn: 蜂巢产物：名字附着在蜂巢的产出上，而非动物本身。

branches.en: BUZZING CROWD: any crowded gathering inherits the hum of the hive.
branches.cn: 嗡鸣的人群：任何拥挤的场合都继承了蜂巢的嗡鸣。

intro.en: Bee is a bare Germanic root; the derived words are English compounds and suffixes attached to it, plus a Latin family borrowed for technical use.
intro.cn: bee 是光秃秃的日耳曼词根；派生词是英语复合与缀合，另有借入技术领域的拉丁词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin apis and its diminutive apicula supply apiary, apiculture and apiarist, none of them cognate with English bee.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 apis 及其指小形式 apicula 衍生出 apiary、apiculture、apiarist，与英语 bee 并不同源。

items.example: A bee works the clover row by row.
items.exampleCN: 一只蜜蜂一行行地采三叶草。

items.example: The honeybee is the most managed pollinator.
items.exampleCN: 蜜蜂是最常被管理的传粉者。

items.example: Smoke calms the beehive before inspection.
items.exampleCN: 检查前先熏烟让蜂群安静。

items.example: The beekeeper moved the hives uphill.
items.exampleCN: 养蜂人把蜂箱移到了高处。

items.example: Beeswax seals the cells of the comb.
A bumblebee queened the nest under the shed.
items.exampleCN: 一只熊蜂在棚下建起了群体。

items.example: She made a beeline for the exit.
He entered the spelling bee at nine.
items.exampleCN: 他九岁参加了拼写比赛。

items.example: Bee pollen is sold as a food supplement.
items.exampleCN: 蜂花粉被当作膳食补充剂出售。

definition_zh: n. 蜂箱；蜂巢；忙碌喧闹之所（喻）；蜂巢式高蓬发型
definition_en: a box or domed structure in which bees live; a place full of busy activity; a tall rounded hairstyle shaped like a straw hive
core_image: 草编的圆顶蜂箱，门口进出不停，里面一片嗡嗡
scene: 办公室里人人都在跑，电话一直没停。The office was a beehive, with everyone moving and the phones never quiet.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：beehive 比喻忙碌喧闹的场所；句意是办公室里人人奔忙、电话不断。

pos.zh: 蜂箱；忙碌之所；蜂巢发型

senses.title: Where bees live
senses.definition: a man-made box or a traditional straw dome housing a colony of bees
senses.definitionCN: 人工蜂箱或传统草编圆顶，容纳一个蜂群
senses.example: He lifted the lid of the beehive without smoke.
senses.exampleCN: 他不用烟就掀开了蜂箱盖。
senses.why: The compound is transparent: bee plus hive, where hive already meant a vessel.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词一目了然：bee「蜂」加 hive「巢」，而 hive 本就意为容器。

senses.title: A busy place
senses.definition: a place where many people work busily and noisily together
senses.definitionCN: 许多人一起忙碌喧闹地工作的地方
senses.example: The newsroom became a beehive before the deadline.
senses.exampleCN: 截稿前编辑部忙成了一片。
senses.why: A colony has many workers in one small space, which is exactly the picture of a busy office.
senses.whyCN: 一个蜂群是在狭小空间里挤满劳作者，这正是忙碌办公室的画面。

senses.title: A tall hairstyle
senses.definition: a hairstyle piled high and rounded on the head, popular in the 1960s
senses.definitionCN: 在头顶高高堆起、盘成圆蓬的发型，1960 年代流行
senses.example: She wore a beehive pinned with a silver comb.
senses.exampleCN: 她梳着蜂巢头，别了一把银梳。
senses.why: The shape of a straw dome is the whole point of the name, so this sense is pure outline.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字全靠草编圆顶的外形，因此该义项纯粹取自轮廓。

intro.en: Beehive joins two very old words: bee, unchanged for a thousand years, and hive, which once meant any rounded vessel.
intro.cn: beehive 拼合了两个极古老的词：bee 千年未变，hive 则曾泛指任何圆形容器。

items.en: The root meant a hollow or rounded container, the idea behind hive.
items.cn: 该词根意为空腔或圆形容器，是 hive 背后的构想。

items.en: Old English beo names the insect, a word unchanged for a thousand years.
items.cn: 古英语 beo 指这种昆虫，千年未变。

items.en: Old English hyf means a vessel or hive, kin to a word for a ship hull.
items.cn: 古英语 hyf 指容器或蜂巢，与「船体」一词同源。

items.en: Middle English joins the two into a single word for the vessel that holds bees.
items.cn: 中古英语把两者合成一词，指盛蜂之器。

items.en: A crowded busy place is called a hive of activity.
items.cn: 拥挤忙碌的场所被称作 a hive of activity。

items.en: A tall rounded hairstyle takes the name from its shape.
items.cn: 一种高耸圆蓬的发型因形状得名。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps bee compounds and the near-homophone behave; the near-meaning group moves from the beekeeper technical terms to the plain word nest.
note.cn: 形近组保留 bee 复合词与近音的 behave；近义组由养蜂专业术语过渡到最朴素的 nest。

entries.definition: A direct straight path to a target.
To act in a particular way.
To lift or pull something heavy.
Wax made by bees for building comb.
A place where many hives are kept.
entries.definitionCN: 放置许多蜂箱的养蜂场。

entries.definition: The wax cells built inside a hive.
entries.definitionCN: 蜂箱内筑起的蜡质巢室。

entries.definition: A traditional domed hive made of straw.
A structure where animals lay eggs or live.
entries.definitionCN: 动物产卵或栖居的构造。

normalIntro.en: Beehive is bee plus hive, and hive once meant a rounded vessel. One shape gives you all three senses: box, busy office, tall hair.
normalIntro.cn: beehive 就是 bee 加 hive，而 hive 曾意为圆形容器。一个形状给出全部三义：蜂箱、忙碌办公室、高耸发型。

normal.en: A straw dome with a small door at the base.
normal.cn: 底部开小门的草编圆顶。

normal.en: Thousands of workers in one small space.
normal.cn: 狭小空间里的成千上万劳作者。

normal.en: A newsroom before deadline is a beehive.
normal.cn: 截稿前的编辑部就是一片蜂箱。

normal.en: Hair piled into the same dome is a beehive.
normal.cn: 头发堆成同样的圆顶也叫 beehive。

normal.en: An apiary is where many beehives stand.
normal.cn: apiary 是摆放许多蜂箱的地方。

abstract.en: Order produced by many small selfish acts.
abstract.cn: 许多微小自利行为合出的秩序。

abstract.en: Noise that turns out to be work.
abstract.cn: 原来就是劳作的喧闹。

abstract.en: A shape borrowed by insects, offices and hairdressers.
abstract.cn: 一个被昆虫、办公室与理发师依次借走的形状。

examples.en: The beehives stood in a row along the orchard wall.
examples.cn: 蜂箱沿果园墙排成一列。

examples.en: By nine the kitchen was a beehive of activity.
examples.cn: 到九点厨房已忙成一片。

examples.en: Her beehive added a hand span to her height.
examples.cn: 蜂巢头让她高出足足一掌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：bee「蜂」+ hive「巢、容器」= beehive 蜂箱。一个圆顶三个用法：蜂箱 → 忙成一团的地方（a beehive of activity）→ 1960 年代蜂巢式高蓬发型。

root: bee 出自古英语 beo，hive 出自古英语 hyf「容器」，与「船体」一词同源，深层为「空腔、圆形容器」之义。约 1300 年合成 beehive；18 世纪生出「忙碌之所」的比喻义，1960 年代因发型形似草编圆顶而再增一义。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses from one outline: the dome itself, the crowd that behaves like a colony, and hair built into the same dome.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项出自同一个轮廓：圆顶本身、像蜂群一样行动的人群，以及堆成同样圆顶的头发。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straw dome with bees streaming in and out of one small door
core.cn: 核心意象：草编圆顶，蜜蜂从一个小门不停进出

branches.en: A lid lifted on a humming box.
Frames drawn out one by one.

branches.cn: 编辑部里电话此起彼伏。

branches.en: Hair pinned into a tall dome.

intro.en: Beehive is two native roots joined; the Latin layer appears only in the beekeeper vocabulary such as apiary.
intro.cn: beehive 是两个本族词根拼合；拉丁语层次只出现在 apiary 这类养蜂用语中。

latinIntro.en: Latin apis means bee, alveare means beehive, and favus means honeycomb; apiary is built on the first of these.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 apis 意为蜂，alveare 意为蜂箱，favus 意为巢脾；apiary 建在第一个之上。

definition_zh: n. 甜菜（藜科植物，根肥厚）；甜菜根（作蔬菜食用）；糖用甜菜（制糖作物）
definition_en: a plant of the genus Beta with a fleshy edible root; the root eaten as a vegetable; the variety grown industrially for sugar
core_image: 卡车把带泥的甜菜根倒进糖厂料槽，泥水顺地面流开
scene: 卡车把甜菜倒进厂区的槽里，泥水顺着地面流开。Lorries tipped the beet into the factory bins, and muddy water ran across the yard.
sceneCN: 第 3 个义项：这里 beet 作不可数的作物名，指制糖用甜菜；句意是卡车把甜菜卸入糖厂料槽。

senses.title: The plant
senses.definition: a plant of the genus Beta grown for its fleshy root or its leaves
senses.definitionCN: 甜菜属植物，为其肥厚根或叶而栽培
senses.example: Beet tolerates cold soil better than most crops.
senses.exampleCN: 甜菜比多数作物更耐冷土。
senses.why: The Latin name beta came into English very early, so the word is older than the crop uses.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语名 beta 很早就进入英语，因此这个词比它的各种作物用途都老。

senses.title: The root as food
senses.definition: the thick red or white root cooked and eaten as a vegetable
senses.definitionCN: 煮熟作蔬菜食用的肥厚红色或白色根
senses.example: Roast the beets until a knife slides in easily.
senses.exampleCN: 把甜菜根烤到刀能轻易插进去。
senses.why: British English prefers beetroot here, while American English keeps the short form.
senses.whyCN: 此义英式英语偏用 beetroot，美式英语保留短形式。

senses.title: The sugar crop
senses.definition: the white-rooted variety grown in bulk as an industrial source of sugar
senses.definitionCN: 白根品种，大规模栽培作工业制糖原料
senses.example: The factory processes two thousand tonnes of beet a day.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂每天加工两千吨甜菜。
senses.why: In this use the word is uncountable, because the crop is measured by weight rather than counted.
senses.whyCN: 此用法中该词不可数，因为作物按重量而非个数计量。

intro.en: Beet is a very early Latin borrowing that waited centuries for its second career. Once the root was shown to hold cane sugar, the word became industrial.
intro.cn: beet 是很早的拉丁语借词，等了几个世纪才迎来第二份职业。一旦证明其根含有蔗糖，这个词就工业化了。

items.en: Latin beta names the plant, perhaps borrowed from a Celtic language.
items.cn: 拉丁语 beta 指这种植物，可能借自某种凯尔特语。

items.en: Old English bete is an early borrowing, grown for leaves as much as roots.
items.cn: 古英语 bete 是早期借词，当时叶与根同样受重视。

items.en: Middle English keeps the name while the red root becomes the main crop.
items.cn: 中古英语保留该名，红色根逐渐成为主要栽培对象。

items.en: A German chemist shows that the root contains the same sugar as cane.
items.cn: 一位德国化学家证明其根含有与甘蔗相同的糖。

items.en: Factories make beet sugar across Europe, and the crop reshapes whole regions.
items.cn: 工厂在欧洲各地生产甜菜糖，这种作物重塑了整片区域。

items.en: Beetroot becomes the British kitchen word, while beet alone stays the crop name.
items.cn: beetroot 成为英国厨房用词，而 beet 单用仍指作物。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the same-sound beat and other short bee- words; the near-meaning group lists the root vegetables beet is confused with.
note.cn: 形近组放同音的 beat 及其他短 bee- 词；近义组列出与甜菜相混的根菜类。

entries.definition: To hit repeatedly, or a rhythm.
To risk money on an outcome.
Meat from cattle.
An alcoholic drink brewed from grain.
The beet root used as a vegetable.
A beet variety eaten for its leaves.
entries.definitionCN: 为食叶而栽的甜菜变种。

entries.definition: A round white root vegetable.
A large yellow-fleshed root vegetable.

normalIntro.en: Beet and beat sound identical: one is a root in the soil, the other a hit or a rhythm. Let the double e point at the vegetable.
normalIntro.cn: beet 与 beat 读音相同：一个是土里的根，一个是击打或节拍。让双写 e 指向蔬菜那一边。

normal.en: Two e letters, one red root.
normal.cn: 两个 e，一条红根。

normal.en: Sugar beet is white and grown by the tonne.
normal.cn: sugar beet 是白根，按吨种植。

normal.en: Beetroot is what British recipes say.
normal.cn: beetroot 是英国食谱的说法。

normal.en: Chard is the same plant grown for leaves.
normal.cn: chard 是同一植物为食叶而栽。

normal.en: Beet sugar and cane sugar are the same sucrose.
normal.cn: 甜菜糖与甘蔗糖是同一种蔗糖。

abstract.en: A cold-climate answer to a tropical plant.
abstract.cn: 一种寒温带作物对热带作物的回应。

abstract.en: Sweetness hidden in something that looks like mud.
abstract.cn: 藏在貌似泥块之物里的甜。

abstract.en: A word that waited centuries for chemistry.
abstract.cn: 一个等了化学几个世纪的词。

examples.en: The beet harvest starts after the first frost.
examples.cn: 甜菜收获在初霜之后开始。

examples.en: She sliced the beets thin for the salad.
examples.cn: 她把甜菜根切薄片做沙拉。

examples.en: Beet sugar filled the gap when cane shipments stopped.
examples.cn: 甘蔗船期中断时，甜菜糖补上了缺口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 同音辨析：beet「甜菜」与 beat「打、节拍」同音，双写 e 记蔬菜。一条线：甜菜植物 → 甜菜根（英式叫 beetroot）→ 糖用甜菜（sugar beet，按吨算，不可数）。

root: 古英语 bete 是很早的拉丁语借词，源自拉丁语 beta「甜菜」，beta 又可能借自凯尔特语。1747 年德国化学家证明其根含蔗糖，19 世纪欧洲兴起甜菜制糖业，该词由此获得工业义；英式厨房用 beetroot，美式保留 beet。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses, one plant: the species in the field, the root on the plate, and the tonnes going into a sugar factory.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项，一种植物：田里的物种、盘里的根，以及成吨送进糖厂的原料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: muddy roots tipping from a lorry into a sugar factory bin
core.cn: 核心意象：带泥的根从卡车倒进糖厂料槽

branches.en: Rows of leaf in cold soil.
A knife sliding into roast root.
A weighbridge queue at the factory.

intro.en: Beet is a short borrowed root; the compounds and the sugar vocabulary supply most of the useful parts.
intro.cn: beet 是一个短的外来词根；复合词与糖类词汇提供了大部分有用构件。

latinIntro.en: Latin beta is the plant name, saccharum means sugar, and radix means root; all three sit behind the technical vocabulary.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 beta 是植物名，saccharum 意为糖，radix 意为根；三者都在专业词汇背后。

definition_zh: 甲虫；鞘翅目昆虫；（口语）匆匆小跑
definition_en: an insect whose front wings are hardened into protective cases over the folded hind wings
core_image: 一段朽木上趴着一只黑亮的甲虫，背上两片硬壳合得严丝合缝，像一扇关紧的柜门
scene: 林子里倒下的树干被雨泡软了，树皮下有许多细小的通道。 A beetle worked its way along the fallen log, its hard wing cases catching the light.
sceneCN: 这里 beetle 指「甲虫」（第 1 个义项：前翅硬化为鞘、覆盖后翅的昆虫）；句意为一只甲虫沿着倒木爬行，坚硬的鞘翅反着光。

derivatives.zh: 眉骨突出、眉头紧锁的（另一词源）

senses.title: The insect with hard wing cases
senses.definition: an insect of the order Coleoptera, whose front wings form hard cases protecting the folded hind wings
senses.definitionCN: 鞘翅目的昆虫，前翅变成硬壳以保护折叠的后翅
senses.example: A beetle worked its way along the fallen log.
senses.exampleCN: 一只甲虫沿着倒木爬行。
senses.why: the hardened wing case is the single feature that defines the group, so the word names the animal by its housing.
senses.whyCN: 硬化的鞘翅是定义这个类群的单一特征，因此这个词以它的「外壳」命名动物。

senses.title: The whole order as a category
senses.titleCN: 作为类目的整个鞘翅目
senses.definition: one of the largest orders of insects, treated as a group in counts, keys and collections
senses.definitionCN: 昆虫中最大的目之一，在计数、检索表与收藏中作为一个群处理
senses.example: Beetles make up a quarter of all known animal species.
senses.exampleCN: 甲虫占已知动物物种的四分之一。
senses.why: once the group is counted, the plural stands for the category rather than for individual animals.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把该群用于计数，复数就代表类目，而不是个别动物。

senses.title: A single named kind
senses.definition: a species or family identified by a qualifier, such as stag, bark or dung beetle
senses.definitionCN: 由限定语指明的种或科，如锹甲、树皮甲虫、蜣螂
senses.example: The stag beetle male carries enormous jaws.
senses.exampleCN: 锹甲的雄性带着巨大的大颚。
senses.why: common names for kinds are made by putting a modifier before the general word.
senses.whyCN: 各类的俗名是在通名之前加修饰语构成的。

senses.title: A pest of timber and stored goods
senses.titleCN: 危害木材与储物的害虫
senses.definition: a species whose larvae bore into wood, grain or flour and cause economic loss
senses.definitionCN: 幼虫钻入木材、谷物或面粉并造成经济损失的物种
senses.example: Bark beetles killed the spruce along the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 树皮甲虫杀死了谷地一路的云杉。
senses.why: an economic role singles out those species whose boring does visible damage.
senses.whyCN: 经济角色挑出那些钻孔造成可见损害的物种。

senses.title: A recycler of dung and carrion
senses.definition: a species that buries or consumes dung, carcasses and dead plant matter
senses.definitionCN: 掩埋或取食粪便、尸体与枯死植物的物种
senses.example: Dung beetles bury waste faster than any machine.
senses.exampleCN: 蜣螂埋粪的速度快过任何机器。
senses.why: ecology names the function rather than the anatomy, so the same word carries a service meaning.
senses.whyCN: 生态学命名功能而非解剖结构，因此同一个词带有「服务」义。

senses.title: A laboratory model organism
senses.definition: a species reared under controlled conditions for genetic or physiological research
senses.definitionCN: 在受控条件下饲养、用于遗传或生理研究的物种
senses.example: The flour beetle is cheap to keep and quick to breed.
senses.exampleCN: 面粉甲虫饲养便宜、繁殖快。
senses.why: a well-known animal becomes a research system, and its name stands for the system.
senses.whyCN: 一种熟悉的动物成为研究体系，其名称代表这个体系。

senses.title: An object of collection and display
senses.definition: the pinned specimen itself, valued for pattern, colour or rarity
senses.definitionCN: 被插针固定的标本本身，因花纹、颜色或稀有而受重视
senses.example: The beetle in the case had been collected in 1889.
senses.exampleCN: 标本盒里那只甲虫是 1889 年采到的。
senses.why: collectors speak of the specimen by the animal's name, so the word can mean the pinned object.
senses.whyCN: 收藏者以动物名指称标本，因此这个词也可指插针的物件。

senses.title: To hurry along, in informal British use
senses.definition: informal, to move quickly with short hurried steps
senses.definitionCN: 口语，指迈着短促急步快速移动
senses.example: She beetled off to catch the last bus.
senses.exampleCN: 她匆匆赶去搭末班车。
senses.why: the verb is often linked to the insect's scuttling walk, though a separate origin has also been suggested, so the link is plausible rather than certain.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词常与昆虫急促的爬行相联系，但也有人提出另有来源，因此这一联系只是可能而非确定。

intro.en: Beetle for the insect goes back to Old English bitela, a derivative of the verb bitan 'to bite'; a separate beetle names a wooden mallet.
intro.cn: 指昆虫的 beetle 可追溯到古英语 bitela，是动词 bitan「咬」的派生词；另有同形的 beetle 指木槌，来源不同。

items.en: Bitela was a small biting creature, formed from bitan 'to bite' with a diminutive ending, and it named beetles.
items.cn: bitela 指会咬的小生物，由 bitan「咬」加指小词尾构成，用来指甲虫。

items.en: German Käfer and Dutch kever are different formations, but the English word belongs to the same Germanic world of biting names.
items.cn: 德语 Käfer 与荷兰语 kever 是不同构词，但英语这个词属于同一套日耳曼「咬」的命名传统。

items.en: A homograph beetle, from Old English bietel, means a heavy wooden mallet; it explains beetle-browed and beetling cliffs, not the insect.
items.cn: 同形的另一个 beetle 出自古英语 bietel，指沉重的木槌；它解释 beetle-browed 与 beetling cliffs，与昆虫无关。

items.en: Coleoptera, from Greek koleos 'sheath' and pteron 'wing', became the order name for beetles in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: Coleoptera 由希腊 koleos「鞘」与 pteron「翅」构成，18 世纪成为甲虫的目名。

items.en: The verb beetle, to scuttle, is recorded from the sixteenth century with an uncertain origin.
items.cn: 动词 beetle「急走」自 16 世纪有记录，来源不确定。

items.en: Source uncertain (verb origin): whether the scuttling verb comes from the insect or from another source is unresolved; the insect noun itself is clear.
items.cn: 来源不确定（动词来源）：急走动词是否来自昆虫或另有来源尚无定论；昆虫名词本身是清楚的。

note.en: Group one separates beetle from insects it is mistaken for; group two separates the insect word from its homograph and from related categories.
note.cn: 第一组区分 beetle 与易被误认的昆虫；第二组区分这个昆虫词与同形词及相关类别。

entries.definition: Everyday for any small crawling insect; technically only the true bugs, which have piercing mouthparts, so a beetle is not a bug.
entries.definitionCN: 日常泛指小爬虫；严格只指口器刺吸的半翅目，因此甲虫不是 bug。

entries.definition: A weevil is a beetle with an elongated snout; it is one family inside Coleoptera, not a separate kind of animal.
entries.definitionCN: 象甲是带长吻的甲虫，属鞘翅目中的一个科，并非另一类动物。

entries.definition: A cockroach has leathery forewings that overlap rather than hard cases meeting in a line; it is not a beetle.
entries.definitionCN: 蟑螂前翅革质交叠，不像甲虫硬鞘沿中线合拢；它不是甲虫。

entries.definition: Built on the mallet sense of beetle, meaning heavy projecting brows; it has nothing to do with insects.
entries.definitionCN: 建在 beetle「木槌」义上，指眉骨重而突出；与昆虫无关。

entries.definition: The whole six-legged class; beetle is the largest order within it.
entries.definitionCN: 整个六足纲；甲虫是其中最大的目。

entries.definition: The jointed-legged phylum that contains beetles along with spiders and crabs.
entries.definitionCN: 具关节足的整个门，甲虫与蜘蛛、蟹都在其中。

entries.definition: A grub is the thick-bodied larva of a beetle; the adult is the beetle itself.
entries.definitionCN: grub 是甲虫粗壮身体的幼虫；成虫才是 beetle。

entries.definition: To scuttle is to run with short quick steps; it is the neutral equivalent of the informal verb beetle.
entries.definitionCN: scuttle 指迈短促快步跑；它是口语动词 beetle 的中性对应词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Old English derivation, real family names and the homograph warning.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实古英语派生、真实科名与同形词警示。

normal.en: Old English bitela comes from bitan 'to bite', so beetle once meant the biting little one.
normal.cn: 古英语 bitela 出自 bitan「咬」，因此 beetle 原意是「会咬的小东西」。

normal.en: Greek koleos 'sheath' plus pteron 'wing' gives Coleoptera, the beetle order.
normal.cn: 希腊 koleos「鞘」加 pteron「翅」构成 Coleoptera，即甲虫目。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: dung beetle, bark beetle, stag beetle.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：蜣螂、树皮甲虫、锹甲。

normal.en: Do not mix the insect with the mallet homograph behind beetle-browed.
normal.cn: 勿把昆虫与 beetle-browed 背后那个「木槌」同形词混为一谈。

normal.en: The larva of a beetle is usually called a grub.
normal.cn: 甲虫的幼虫通常叫 grub。

abstract.en: Picture two cupboard doors shut over folded cloth inside.
abstract.cn: 想象两扇柜门合起，里面是折好的布。

abstract.en: Picture a small body that can survive being stepped on.
abstract.cn: 想象一具小身体，被踩一脚也还能活。

abstract.en: Picture a walk so hurried it looks like scuttling.
abstract.cn: 想象一种急到像在窜的走法。

examples.en: Beetles were the first animals to be used in this kind of experiment.
examples.cn: 甲虫是最早被用于这类实验的动物。

examples.en: The log was riddled with beetle galleries under the bark.
examples.cn: 树皮下的木头被甲虫的虫道蛀得满是孔。

examples.en: He beetled across the yard before the rain started.
examples.cn: 雨还没下，他就匆匆穿过院子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「beetle」——背上两片硬壳像柜门一样合上 → 甲虫

root: 古英语 bitela「甲虫」，由 bitan「咬」加指小词尾构成；另有同形词 beetle 出自古英语 bietel「木槌」，二者不同源。动词「急走」来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one hard case: an insect folds its wings under two shutters, and the word then names the order, a species, a timber pest, a waste recycler, a laboratory animal, a pinned specimen, and finally a hurried walk.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一副硬壳展开：昆虫把翅折在两扇「柜门」下；词语随后指整个目、某一物种、木材害虫、废物回收者、实验室动物、插针标本，最后指一种匆忙的走法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hard shutters meeting in a straight line over folded wings.
core.cn: 核心意象：两片硬壳沿一条直线合拢，盖住折叠的翅。

branches.en: BODY AND ORDER: the shutters of one beetle, then the largest order of insects.
branches.cn: 身体与目：一只甲虫的鞘翅，然后是昆虫中最大的目。

branches.en: NAMED KIND: stag, bark and dung beetles are modifiers on one word.
branches.cn: 具名种类：锹甲、树皮甲虫、蜣螂都是同一词上的修饰语。

branches.en: TWO ECONOMIES: one species destroys timber, another removes waste.
branches.cn: 两种经济：一种毁木材，另一种清废物。

branches.en: HUMAN USES: a research system and a collected object.
branches.cn: 人的用途：一个研究体系与一件被收藏之物。

branches.en: THE WALK: the scuttle borrows the insect's hurried gait, though the origin is uncertain.
branches.cn: 走法：急走借用了昆虫仓促的步态，尽管来源不确定。

intro.en: Beetle is a native noun formed with an old diminutive ending; the modern word is monomorphemic to most speakers.
intro.cn: beetle 是本族名词，由古老的指小词尾构成；对多数使用者而言现代词已不可再分。

latinIntro.en: Latin contributes only the scientific order name Coleoptera, from Greek; beetle itself has no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语只提供学术目名 Coleoptera（本身出自希腊语）；beetle 自身不含拉丁词根。

items.example: The name began as 'the biting one'.
items.exampleCN: 这个名字起初是「会咬的那个」。

items.example: The ending made the name a small creature word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾使名词成为「小生物」的说法。

items.example: The beetle closed its wing cases.
Dung beetles roll the dung away.
Bark beetles spread in warm winters.
The stag beetle is protected here.
Beetle-browed comes from the mallet, not the insect.
items.exampleCN: beetle-browed 出自木槌而非昆虫。

items.example: A beetling cliff hung over the path.
items.exampleCN: 一片突出的崖壁悬在路上。

latinEntries.meaning: a mask, a ghost; later a young stage

definition_zh: 事先；预先；提前；事前
definition_en: earlier than a particular time, event, or action; in advance
core_image: 事情还没发生，手已经先伸到前面去了：把准备做在时间的前头
scene: 开会前她把资料全都打印装订好了，等大家到场就能直接讨论，一点不慌乱。She prepared all the documents beforehand, so the meeting went smoothly.
sceneCN: 这里 beforehand 是「事先、预先」（第 1 个义项：早于某个时间或事件发生）；句意是她在会议开始之前就把资料准备好了，因此会议进行得很顺利。

derivatives.zh: 由「after（之后）+ hand」构成的对应词，义为「事后」（罕用，多见于早期英语）
由 beforehand 加名词后缀构成的罕用名词，义为「预先性；提前状态」
相关近义词，义为「前进；预先」（in advance 短语与 beforehand 同义）

senses.title: Earlier than a particular time or event
senses.titleCN: 事先；在某个时间或事件之前
senses.definition: at an earlier time than something happens or is done
senses.definitionCN: 在事情发生或完成之前的时间点上
senses.example: She prepared all the documents beforehand.
senses.exampleCN: 她事先把所有文件都准备好了。
senses.why: The compound joins before with hand, as if time were held and handled before the moment arrives.
senses.whyCN: 复合词把 before（在前）和 hand（手）组合起来，仿佛时间被握在手里、先一步递到事情发生之前。

senses.title: In advance, as a preparation
senses.definition: in advance so that one is ready when the time comes
senses.definitionCN: 提前安排妥当，等到关键时刻不至于手忙脚乱
senses.example: If you book the tickets beforehand, you will pay less.
senses.exampleCN: 如果你提前订票，价格会便宜一些。
senses.why: Doing the work in advance shifts effort from the busy moment to the calm one before it.
senses.whyCN: 把功夫下在前头，等于把忙碌时刻的工作挪到之前从容的时段里完成。

senses.title: Before doing something else, as a first step
senses.definition: as a prior step before moving on to something else
senses.definitionCN: 作为先行的步骤，把某事处理完再谈下一步
senses.example: Read the contract beforehand before you sign it.
senses.exampleCN: 签字之前要先读一遍合同。
senses.why: The word marks sequence: one action must be handled ahead of another.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标记先后顺序：一件事必须先于另一件事处理。

senses.title: Ahead of other people, earlier than others
senses.definition: earlier than other people manage to do or know something
senses.definitionCN: 在别人之前完成或了解到某事
senses.example: He knew the result beforehand because he had seen the list.
senses.exampleCN: 他提前知道了结果，因为他看过名单。
senses.why: Being ahead in time also means being ahead of everyone else who waits.
senses.whyCN: 在时间上领先，也意味着领先于那些还在等待的人。

senses.title: With advance knowledge or notice
senses.titleCN: 预先获知；事先得到消息
senses.definition: with knowledge of something before it is announced or happens
senses.definitionCN: 在事情公布或发生之前就已知晓
senses.example: Nobody told me beforehand that the plan had changed.
senses.exampleCN: 事先没有人告诉我计划变了。
senses.why: Information received early lets a person act as if the future were already in hand.
senses.whyCN: 提前拿到信息，就像把未来的事情先握在手里一样。

senses.title: In prior arrangement or agreement
senses.definition: as something arranged or agreed before the occasion itself
senses.definitionCN: 指在正式场合之前就已经谈好、定好的安排
senses.example: We had agreed beforehand to split the cost equally.
senses.exampleCN: 我们事先说好了平摊费用。
senses.why: An agreement made ahead binds both sides before the event arrives.
senses.whyCN: 事先达成的约定在事情到来之前就已约束双方。

senses.title: Anticipating future needs, planning ahead
senses.titleCN: 未雨绸缪地；为将来打算
senses.definition: with thought given to future needs before they arise
senses.definitionCN: 在需求出现之前就预作打算
senses.example: Thinking beforehand about possible problems saved the team a lot of trouble.
senses.exampleCN: 提前考虑可能出现的问题，为团队省去了很多麻烦。
senses.why: The mind reaches forward in time, handling tomorrow's tasks today.
senses.whyCN: 思绪提前伸向未来，把明天的事拿到今天来处理。

senses.title: In negative and interrogative uses, impossibility of prior knowledge
senses.titleCN: 用于否定或疑问：无法事先知道
senses.definition: used to say that something could not be known or done in advance
senses.definitionCN: 常用于否定句或疑问句，表示某事无法预先知道或做到
senses.example: I could not have known beforehand that the flight would be cancelled.
senses.exampleCN: 我事先不可能知道航班会被取消。
senses.why: Negation flips the image: the hand did not reach forward, so surprise follows.
senses.whyCN: 否定翻转了意象：手没有先伸出去，于是意外接踵而来。

intro.en: Beforehand is a native English compound of before plus hand, formed within Middle English and parallel to the rarer afterhand.
intro.cn: beforehand 是英语本土复合词，由 before（在前）加 hand（手）构成，形成于中古英语时期，与罕用的 afterhand（事后）相对应。

items.en: Before comes from Old English beforan, itself be- (by, about) plus foran (in front of), a spatial word later extended to time.
items.cn: before 源自古英语 beforan，由 be-（在、关于）加 foran（在前方）构成，原本表示空间方位，后来引申为时间上的先后。

items.en: Hand is a common Germanic noun, Old English hand, found in many compound expressions for possession and action.
items.cn: hand 是常见的日耳曼语名词，古英语作 hand，在英语中大量出现于表示掌握、动作的复合表达里。

items.en: The compound beforehand is first recorded in the late fourteenth century, meaning at an earlier point or in front.
items.cn: 复合词 beforehand 最早见于十四世纪晚期，意为「在更早的时点；在前方」。

items.en: The sense narrows to in advance, in anticipation, and the word settles into its modern adverbial use alongside the rare parallel afterhand.
items.cn: 词义逐渐收窄为「提前、预先」，该词固定为现代副词用法，与罕用的对应词 afterhand（事后）并存。

items.en: Today beforehand is the standard adverb for doing or knowing something in advance, common in both everyday and formal contexts.
items.cn: 如今 beforehand 是表示「事先、预先」的标准副词，日常与正式语体中都十分常用。

note.en: The first group gathers words built from the same before- and fore- material; the second gathers near-synonymous ways of saying in advance.
note.cn: 第一组收录由 before-、fore- 等相同材料构成的词；第二组收录表示「提前、预先」的近义说法。

entries.definition: a stroke made with the palm of the hand facing forward; shares the -hand element but means a forward hand position, not time
entries.definitionCN: 正手；与 beforehand 共享 -hand 成分，但指手掌朝前的击球方式，与时间无关，只是构词相近。

entries.definition: a system of quick writing using symbols; ends in -hand like beforehand but refers to a shortened hand method, not time
entries.definitionCN: 速记；与 beforehand 一样以 -hand 结尾，但指缩略的书写方法，只是构词方式相似，词义不同。

entries.definition: the rare mirror compound meaning afterward; built with -hand exactly like beforehand but pointing the other way in time
entries.definitionCN: 事后（罕用）；与 beforehand 用同样方式以 -hand 构成的镜像词，只是时间方向相反。

entries.definition: ahead of the time when something happens; the common phrase-level equivalent of beforehand
entries.definitionCN: 提前；beforehand 最常见的短语级同义表达。

entries.definition: too early, before the proper time; adds a nuance of being earlier than is right
entries.definitionCN: 过早地；提前得不止一步而是过了头，带有不合时宜的贬义色彩。

entries.definition: earlier than the expected or required time
entries.definitionCN: 比预期或要求的时间早；与 beforehand 同义而更口语化。

normalIntro.en: The five associations below build on the real compound before plus hand.
normalIntro.cn: 以下五条联想都基于真实的复合结构 before（在前）加 hand（手）。

normal.en: before + hand: your hand reaches before the moment arrives
normal.cn: before 加 hand：手先伸到时刻到来之前

normal.en: beforehand and afterhand are a pair, one ahead and one behind
normal.cn: beforehand 与 afterhand 是一对，一个在前一个在后

normal.en: before itself is be- plus foran, in front
normal.cn: before 本身由 be- 加 foran 构成，义为在前方

normal.en: same family: before, beforelong, beforehand all point earlier in time
normal.cn: 同族词：before、beforelong、beforehand 都指向更早的时间

normal.en: collocation anchor: know beforehand, plan beforehand, prepare beforehand
normal.cn: 搭配锚点：know beforehand（事先知道）、plan beforehand（预先计划）、prepare beforehand（提前准备）

abstract.en: Picture posting the letter a day before the deadline, the queue already behind you
abstract.cn: 想象在截止日前一天就把信寄出，队伍还没排起来你已办完

abstract.en: Feel the calm of a packed suitcase by the door the night before travel
abstract.cn: 感受出发前夜行李箱已收好立在门边的那份从容

abstract.en: Imagine holding tomorrow in your hand today
abstract.cn: 想象今天就把明天握在手里

examples.en: If you book the tickets beforehand, you will pay less.
examples.cn: 如果你提前订票，价格会便宜一些。

examples.en: Nobody told me beforehand that the plan had changed.
examples.cn: 事先没有人告诉我计划变了。

examples.en: The notice arrived late, so there was no time to prepare.
examples.cn: 通知来得很晚，根本没时间准备。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必福汉德」——必先福在手：福气要先握在手里，事情就能顺利，正如 beforehand 强调事先把一切安排妥当。

root: 英语本土复合词：before（源自古英语 beforan，be- 加 foran「在前」）+ hand（古英语 hand「手」），十四世纪晚期合成，义为「在事前、提前」，与罕用的 afterhand（事后）相对应。

sensesIntro.en: From the core image of reaching ahead in time, the senses move from simple priority to preparation, prior knowledge, prior agreement, and the negative case of not knowing in advance.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「把手伸到时间前头」的核心意象出发，义项由单纯的时间领先，扩展到预先准备、预先知情、事先约定，以及否定用法中的「无法预知」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the hand reaching before the moment, doing and knowing ahead of time
core.cn: 核心意象：手伸到时刻到来之前，把事情先做好、先知道

branches.en: Sheer time priority, ahead of the event or of other people
branches.cn: 单纯的时间领先，早于事件或早于他人

branches.en: Preparation done in advance so the moment goes smoothly
branches.cn: 提前做好准备，让关键时刻从容不迫

branches.en: Prior steps and agreements that bind before the occasion
branches.cn: 先行步骤与事先约定，在场合到来之前就定好

branches.en: Advance knowledge and its failure, knowing or not knowing in advance
branches.cn: 预先知情及其反面，知道或无法事先知道
为将来需求预作打算的远虑

intro.en: Beforehand is a compound, not an affixed word, so the items below cover its building blocks and the parallel time-words formed the same way.
intro.cn: beforehand 是复合词而非派生词，因此下列条目介绍它的构件，以及按同样方式构成的时间类平行词。

latinIntro.en: English has no Latin root here, but Latin ante (before) and manus (hand) offer classical parallels to the two parts of the compound.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语词根，但拉丁语 ante（在前）与 manus（手）恰好对应复合词的两个部分，可作古典参照。

items.meaning: the hand, used figuratively for control or action
items.example: The matter is in hand now.
items.exampleCN: 这件事现在已在处理之中。

items.example: The garden is beflowered in spring.
Check the forecast before you sail.

items.exampleCN: 后来我们谈起了这件事。

items.meaning: to see something before it happens
items.example: No one could foresee the delay.
items.exampleCN: 没人能预见到这次延误。

latinEntries.exampleCN: ante meridiem 意为中午之前。

latinEntries.example: Manuscript originally meant written by hand.
latinEntries.exampleCN: manuscript 一词原义是用手写成。

derivatives.zh: 由 fore-（预先）加 knowledge（知识）构成，义为「预知；预知能力」
由 fore-（预先）加 thought（思考）构成，义为「深谋远虑；预先考虑」

definition_zh: v. 使积满污垢；弄脏（尤指长期积累的烟垢油污）；（喻）使蒙污、败坏名声
definition_en: to cover with ingrained dirt, especially accumulated soot or grease; figuratively, to soil a reputation
core_image: 矿工升井时那张只剩眼白与牙齿还亮着的脸
scene: 矿工上来时，只有眼白和牙齿还是亮的。The miners came up with faces begrimed, only the eyes and teeth still bright.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：begrimed 指被污垢覆满；句意是矿工升井时满脸积垢，只有眼睛与牙齿还亮。

senses.title: To coat with dirt
senses.definition: to make something dirty with grime that has built up over time
senses.definitionCN: 使某物覆上长期积累的污垢
senses.example: Years of coal smoke had begrimed the stone.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的煤烟把石头熏得发黑。
senses.why: The prefix be- means all over, so the verb describes a covering rather than a single mark.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 be- 意为「遍覆」，因此该动词描写的是覆盖，而非单个污点。

senses.title: To soil a reputation
senses.definition: figuratively, to blacken a name or record as if with soot
senses.definitionCN: 比喻义，指像被煤烟熏黑一样使名声或记录蒙污
senses.example: The scandal begrimed an otherwise clean record.
senses.exampleCN: 那桩丑闻给本来清白的记录抹了黑。
senses.why: Dirt on the surface becomes dirt on the character, a transfer English makes very readily.
senses.whyCN: 表面的脏转为品格的脏，这是英语极为顺手的一种引申。

intro.en: Begrime is the covering prefix be- plus grime, a Low Countries word for soot. The participle begrimed is far more common than the bare verb.
intro.cn: begrime 是「遍覆」前缀 be- 加 grime——一个来自低地国家的「煤烟」词。分词 begrimed 远比动词原形常用。

items.en: Old English be- could cover something all over, as in besmear and bedaub.
items.cn: 古英语 be- 可表「遍覆其上」，如 besmear、bedaub。

items.en: A Germanic root meant to smear or to rub in, the base of grime.
items.cn: 一个日耳曼语词根意为涂抹、擦入，是 grime 的基础。

items.en: Middle Dutch grime means soot or smut, and English takes it in about 1500.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 grime 意为煤灰、烟垢，英语约 1500 年借入。

items.en: English adds the covering prefix to make a verb meaning to coat with dirt.
items.cn: 英语加上「遍覆」前缀造出该动词，意为覆满污垢。

items.en: Writers extend the word to reputations blackened by scandal.
items.cn: 文人把该词扩用于被丑闻涂黑的名声。

items.en: The participle becomes the commonest form, describing coal towns and faces.
items.cn: 分词形式成为最常用形式，用来描写煤城与面孔。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps other be- verbs so the prefix pattern becomes visible; the near-meaning group grades soiling from physical to moral.
note.cn: 形近组保留其他 be- 动词，使前缀规律显形；近义组把「弄脏」由物理到道德分级排列。

entries.definition: To charm or trick someone pleasantly.
entries.definitionCN: 以魅力诱骗或迷住某人。

entries.definition: To resent someone having something.
entries.definitionCN: 对他人的所得心生不甘。

entries.definition: To smear all over with something greasy.
Dirt ingrained on a surface.
To make something dirty.
To dirty, especially a reputation.
To make black, literally or morally.
To spoil the purity of something.

normalIntro.en: Be- means all over, grime means soot: begrime is to put soot all over something. Learn the participle first.
normalIntro.cn: be- 意为「遍覆」，grime 意为「煤烟」：begrime 就是把煤烟覆满某物。先记分词形式。

normal.en: Grime is the dirt that will not wash off easily.
normal.cn: grime 是不易洗掉的积垢。

normal.en: Be- spreads it over the whole surface.
normal.cn: be- 把它铺满整个表面。

normal.en: Begrimed faces come up from the pit.
normal.cn: begrimed 的面孔从矿井里升上来。

normal.en: Compare besmear and bedaub, same prefix.
normal.cn: 对照 besmear、bedaub，同一前缀。

normal.en: A begrimed record is a moral use.
normal.cn: a begrimed record 是道德层面的用法。

abstract.en: Dirt that has been given time to settle.
abstract.cn: 被给予了时间沉落下来的脏。

abstract.en: A surface that records its own history.
abstract.cn: 一个记录着自身历史的表面。

abstract.en: Soot as evidence of work done.
abstract.cn: 煤烟作为劳作过的证据。

examples.en: The engine was begrimed with old oil.
examples.cn: 发动机上积满了陈年油污。

examples.en: Begrimed windows let in almost no light.
examples.cn: 积垢的窗几乎透不进光。

examples.en: Nothing could begrime his standing in the town.
examples.cn: 什么也败坏不了他在镇上的声望。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：be-「遍覆」+ grime「煤烟积垢」= begrime 弄得到处是垢。最常见的是分词 begrimed（begrimed with soot）。同类前缀：besmear、bedaub、begrudge。

root: 由前缀 be-「遍覆、彻底」加名词 grime 构成；grime 约 1500 年从中古荷兰语 grime「煤灰、烟垢」借入，深层日耳曼语词根意为涂抹。begrime 约 1530 年代出现，17 世纪扩出败坏名声的比喻义，实际使用中分词 begrimed 最常见。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses, one layer: soot settled on stone, and scandal settled on a name.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项，一层覆盖：落在石头上的煤烟，与落在名声上的丑闻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a miner face where only eyes and teeth are still bright
core.cn: 核心意象：矿工脸上只有眼白与牙齿还亮着

branches.en: A pit cage rising at dawn.
A headline over a clean record.
branches.cn: 清白记录之上的一条标题。

branches.en: A name that will not come clean.
A layer time has pressed in.

intro.en: The key part is the prefix be-, which turns a noun into a verb of covering; the rest build the adjective and moral synonyms.
intro.cn: 关键构件是前缀 be-，它把名词变成「覆盖」义动词；其余部分构成形容词与道德层面的近义词。

latinIntro.en: Latin sordidus means dirty, denigrare to blacken, and fuligo soot; denigrate is the learned twin of the figurative sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sordidus 意为脏，denigrare 意为抹黑，fuligo 意为煤烟；denigrate 是比喻义的书面孪生词。
